# Security Review Supplement

Use only for the currently assigned Forge gate. Identify trust boundaries,
permissions, request validation, secrets handling, and abuse/failure paths.
Classify findings as observed, inferred, or unresolved. Provide actionable
acceptance criteria or test scenarios, not unsupported claims.
Never change approved scope or bypass Forge approval or Git policy.
